title: Avro Lancaster R5694
memorial_details:
description: Squadron crest: BOMBER SQUADRON / CCVII CCVII / ROYAL AIR FORCE / SEMPER PARATUS //  
Inscription: IN MEMORY OF / THE CREW OF LANCASTER BOMBER / R5694 EM-F / Which crashed near this site on November 25th 1942 / with the loss of all those on board. / (8 NAMES) / 'When You Go Home, Tell Them Of Us And Say, / For Your Tomorrow, We Gave Our Today.'
